g.text: Min heap removal: fill the root hole, then follow the smaller child
The last occupied slot supplies the replacement; the active heap loses one slot.
1. Save minimum 1; take the last value 3
Move 3 from index 5 to index 0, then remove index 5 from the active heap.
Choose the smaller child, 2. Swapping with 5 would leave 2 smaller than its parent.
3. Swap 3 with 2; stop at a leaf
Return saved value 1. The complete shape and min-heap order now hold again.
With one element, save and remove that element. There is no replacement path to repair.
